legal_entity: Shakepay Inc. (distributor of the card per the cardholder agreement); not restated on the referral page.
application_conditions: Existing Shakepay account holder sharing the in-app link (Settings > Refer a friend). No publisher, affiliate or media programme is described on shakepay.com, help.shakepay.com or legal.shakepay.com (search 2026-11-17).
paid_action: Referred new user completes phone, email and identity verification, funds the account in CAD and buys at least CAD 100 of digital currency.
validation_conditions: Bonus credited to both accounts within up to 1 day after the conditions are met (help article).

commission.model_note: Flat CAD 20 to referrer and CAD 20 to the new user (amount depends on sign-up date; historical table CAD 5–30). Not linked to card orders or card spend.

payout.method: Credited to the Shakepay account (asset not named on the page)
payout.holdbacks_note: Governed by the Benefits and Rewards Terms (legal.shakepay.com/rewards), not read in this run.

rules_note: Customer-to-customer programme; commercial use by a comparison site is not addressed on the page read. Terms of Use – Referral Codes at legal.shakepay.com/rewards (not read). Nobody contacted, no application made.
allowed_countries_note: Canada only (Shakepay operates exclusively in Canada).

evidence.title: Referral bonus (Shakepay help centre, 3 March 2026)
evidence.excerpt: 'you'll each get $20*' when a referred friend verifies, funds in CAD and buys $100 of digital currency; amount depends on sign-up date (table $5–$30); credited within 1 day; link shared from Settings > Refer a friend; terms at legal.shakepay.com/rewards. No publisher programme.

notes: No publisher/affiliate programme found; the card can be listed without monetisation. Directory kkinvesting.io also states no Shakepay referral link exists for publishers (discovery only).
